question:

2, 4, 7, 11, 16, ?
solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **Consecutive numbers starting from 2 has been added to the terms to get the next term of the series.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9674c6da72de1c9670651da56471537e2f5e2d6f6d1a8c0a2f88506d4f5a0921.png]
